source.title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: ARES trains lightweight judges on synthetic examples, then combines predictions and human labels through prediction-powered inference for aggregate system estimates and confidence intervals. Such an interval describes an aggregate metric under the method’s assumptions; it does not certify each answer. Give a support judge the question, versioned admitted evidence, claims and citations. Validate supported examples, contradictions, missing evidence, valid paraphrases and bounded abstentions.
teaching.moment: Separate synthetic judge training from human-labeled calibration and aggregate prediction-powered inference.
teaching.scope: The confidence interval belongs to a system estimate; it neither certifies each answer nor authorizes retrieval.
teaching.caption: Synthetic examples train judges; human labels calibrate aggregate confidence intervals.
